name: yandex-reviews-service-root
description: Сервис сбора отзывов и карточек организаций с Яндекс.Карт (Laravel + Vue 3 SPA)

scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && composer phpstan && composer format:test
scripts.format: cd backend && composer format && cd ../frontend && npm run lint:fix
scripts.test:e2e: cd frontend && npm run build && npx concurrently -k -s first "npx vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173" "npx wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4173 && npx playwright test"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && composer install && php artisan key:generate && php artisan migrate
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
